variables.ma_on: {{ states.switch | selectattr('entity_id', 'match', '^switch.magic_areas_light_groups_.+_light_control$') | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | map(attribute='entity_id') | map('replace', 'switch.magic_areas_light_groups_', '') | map('replace', '_light_control', '') | reject('in', ['corridor']) | list }}
variables.stored: {% set s = states('input_text.house_away_paused') %}{{ [] if s in ['unknown', 'unavailable', 'none', ''] else s.split(',') | reject('eq', '') | list }}

variables.act: {% set a = states('alarm_control_panel.home') %}{% if trigger.id == 'away' %}{{ 'none' if trigger.from_state.state in ['triggered', 'pending'] else 'pause' }}{% elif stored | count > 0 and a in ['disarmed', 'armed_home', 'armed_night'] %}restore{% else %}none{% endif %}
variables.pause_ids: {% set ns = namespace(l=[]) %}{% for a in ma_on %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + ['switch.magic_areas_light_groups_' ~ a ~ '_light_control'] %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.l }}
variables.restore: {% set have = states.switch | map(attribute='entity_id') | list %}{% set ns = namespace(l=[]) %}{% for a in stored %}{% set e = 'switch.magic_areas_light_groups_' ~ a ~ '_light_control' %}{% if e in have %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + [e] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.l }}

variables.open_now: {{ states.binary_sensor | selectattr('attributes.device_class', 'defined') | selectattr('attributes.device_class', 'in', ['door', 'window', 'opening', 'garage_door']) | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | map(attribute='attributes.friendly_name') | list }}
variables.still_on: {% set l = states('sensor.lighting_left_on') %}{{ [] if l in ['none', 'unknown', 'unavailable'] else l.split(', ') | map('state_attr', 'friendly_name') | list }}

variables.note: {% set n = ['Lights and media are off; presence lighting is paused in ' ~ (paused | count) ~ ' room' ~ ('' if paused | count == 1 else 's') ~ '.'] %}{% if open_now %}{% set n = n + ['Still open: ' ~ open_now | join(', ') ~ '.'] %}{% endif %}{% if still_on %}{% set n = n + ['Still on: ' ~ still_on | join(', ') ~ '.'] %}{% endif %}{% if not open_now and not still_on %}{% set n = n + ['Nothing open.'] %}{% endif %}{{ n | join(' ') }}

description: Operator 2026-10-13/14: leaving = Away, and Away turns the house's automations off. On Away: presence lighting (each room's Magic Areas light_control) is paused - only the rooms where it was on, remembered in input_text.house_away_paused so a restart loses nothing - then every indoor light and media player is switched off, and a minute later both adults get one note naming anything still open or on. The corridor keeps its presence lighting: it is the way in to the keypad. Coming back (Disarmed, Home or Night) restores exactly the rooms that were paused. Climate is not here: the climate loop already drops to its away band after 30 min of Away. Tests: tests/climate/cases.py (away). Review 2026-10-14: M1 - an alarm or entry delay ending back in Away does not run the sequence again; M2 - an Away cancelled within the minute sends no note.
